verdict.rationale: Persona's Hosted Flow explicitly supports a no-code, redirect-based verification link ('fastest setup, no frontend code required' and 'fastest way without any code') which fits sending a link to a one-off individual without engineering. However, there is no explicit evidence of a QR-code generation feature, nor of an ops-lead-facing dashboard UI to generate/send one-off links without any engineering setup for template configuration. missing for 10: explicit QR code support, evidence of a self-serve ops dashboard for creating/sending one-off links without any initial engineering setup.
